backend/main.mo: Defines the backend actor with data types for patients, labs, medications, ADRs, narrations, resources, drugs, and interaction models; storage is mixed in via MixinStorage.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence records linking feature IDs to affected frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Provides human‑written summaries of various frontend files for reference and documentation.
frontend/.env.local: Local development environment variables for canister IDs, network, host, and dev server config.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app container handling identity login, profile loading, query client setup, and conditional UI flow.
frontend/src/backend.idl.ts: IDL definitions describing the backend canister’s types and schemas for frontend consumption.
frontend/src/components/AddPatientDialog: Dialog component for creating a patient with validation, BMI calculation, and form field helpers.
frontend/src/components/AdrForm.tsx: Form for submitting an ADR entry with validation, focus handling, and mutation to backend.
frontend/src/components/AdrsModule.tsx: Displays patient info and ADR history with tabs for recording or viewing ADRs.
frontend/src/components/CaseEntry.tsx: Main case entry module providing tabbed forms for labs, medications, ADRs, prescriber details, and summary.
frontend/src/components/CaseSummary.tsx: Generates a full patient case summary by fetching labs, medications, ADRs, and prescriber data.
frontend/src/components/DisclaimersSecti: Static list of application disclaimers with icon mapping and styled presentation.
frontend/src/components/DrugDetailsModal: Displays detailed drug info in a modal with fallbacks, formatting, and status badges.
frontend/src/components/DrugDrugInteract: Provides searchable drug interaction database UI with tabs, filtering, details, and monograph lookup.
frontend/src/components/DrugInteractions: Handles multi-drug, drug-food, and food-food interaction checks with tabs, summaries, and result cards.
frontend/src/components/DrugMonographSec: Renders drug monograph sections such as pharmacokinetics and safety with fallback messaging.
Lists drugs with filtering, search, tabs, sync status, and a modal for detailed drug information.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Displays the site footer with branding and disclaimer text.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Shows header with branding, user profile display, and logout handling.
frontend/src/components/LabResultsForm.t: Form for submitting lab results with numeric validation, focus management, and mutation handling.
frontend/src/components/LabResultsModule: Displays patient details and tabs for entering or viewing lab results fetched from queries.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Login screen using Internet Identity with async logo preloading and error handling.
frontend/src/components/MedicationForm.t: Form for adding medications with required and date validation, focus management, and mutation submission.
frontend/src/components/MedicationsModul: Shows patient info and tabs for adding or listing medications filtered from fetched data.
frontend/src/components/MonthlyBanTrends: Computes yearly drug ban counts and displays summary cards and a chart in a dialog.
frontend/src/components/MukabotWidget.ts: Empty component file with no implementation.
frontend/src/components/NameAutocomplete: Provides an input with filtered autocomplete suggestions, keyboard navigation, and click-outside handling.
frontend/src/components/PatientDetailsDi: Loads and displays detailed patient info including labs, medications, and ADRs in a dialog with memoized subcomponents.
frontend/src/components/PatientManagemen: Lists patients with BMI tagging, supports viewing, selecting, adding, and deleting patients using dialogs.
frontend/src/components/PreclinicalDataF: Empty placeholder file for a preclinical data form.
frontend/src/components/PreclinicalDataM: Empty placeholder file for a preclinical data module.
frontend/src/components/PrescriberDetail: Displays and edits prescriber details with validation, form state, and save functionality.
frontend/src/components/PrescriptionUplo: Empty component file for prescription upload.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal for setting up user profile with validation, input focus handling, and save mutation.
frontend/src/components/RestrictedDrugsM: UI module listing restricted drugs by category with search, collapsible sections, and external resource links.
frontend/src/components/StartupProfileRe: Banner that notifies users of delayed profile loading and provides retry and logout actions.
frontend/src/components/WavebotWidget.ts: Interactive chat-style widget integrating patient and lab data with external resource metadata.
frontend/src/data/curatedDrugDataset.ts: Large curated drug dataset with normalization and deduplication utilities, including banned and approved drugs.
frontend/src/data/drugFoodInteractionsDa: Dataset of drug–food interactions with clinical details, evidence levels, and management recommendations.
frontend/src/data/drugInteractionExample: Preset drug interaction example sets with helpers to load and validate them.
Defines the DrugMonograph interface and provides a detailed dataset of pharmacokinetic profiles, side effects, contraindications, and population guidance for multiple drugs.
frontend/src/data/foodFoodInteractionsDa: Defines the FoodFoodInteraction interface and a dataset describing interaction severity, effects, and management guidance for various food pairs.
frontend/src/data/foodList.ts: Exports a canonical list of food names for autocomplete and lookup, plus a helper to return all items.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching and mutating patients, labs, medications, and interaction checks using the backend actor and local services.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light/dark themes, color variables, and utility classes optimized for performance and animations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point initializing React, providers for query and identity, and mounting the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: React dashboard with tabbed modules, lazy loading, prefetching, and patient state management.
frontend/src/services/cdscoDrugService.t: Client-side service simulating CDSCO banned drug data with caching and sample entries.
frontend/src/services/drugDrugInteractio: Manages drug interaction database with caching, defaults, and structured interaction details.
frontend/src/services/drugInteractionInd: Builds and caches a normalized drug-interaction index for fast pair lookups.
frontend/src/services/drugInteractionVer: Handles live interaction verification from MIMS/Toaz with caching and scheduled sync.
frontend/src/services/drugMonographServi: Resolves normalized drug names to monograph data with a cached index.
frontend/src/services/foodInteractionInd: Caches and looks up drug–food and food–food interactions using normalized keys.
frontend/src/services/interactionNameCat: Builds unique drug and food name lists and filters suggestions using normalization.
frontend/src/services/localInteractionCh: Computes drug‑drug, drug‑food, and food‑food interactions by pairing inputs and mapping lookup results.
frontend/src/services/multiSourceDrugSer: Aggregates and caches drug data from multiple sources with deterministic merging and scheduled background syncs.
frontend/src/utils/dateParsing.ts: Converts, validates, and formats dates using bigint nanosecond timestamps.
frontend/src/utils/drugPairs.ts: Normalizes drug names, generates unique drug pairs, and formats pair labels.
frontend/src/utils/formValidation.ts: Provides common form validators for required fields, email, phone, numeric input, and error extraction.
frontend/src/utils/interactionSummary.ts: Computes overall severity/toxicity summaries for interactions and formats display labels.
frontend/src/utils/nameNormalization.ts: Normalizes names for consistent matching and detects duplicates based on normalized forms.
frontend/src/utils/namePairs.ts: Generates unique name pairs and formats pair labels.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration enabling dark mode, custom colors using OKLCH variables, extended palettes, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state file describing known issues, existing features, and a pending request to fix outdated interaction-check results after manual input.
